buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) 1. REGISTERED OFFICE IN KERALA 1.1. The bidder/OEM must have a registered office in the State of Kerala. 1.2. The bidder shall upload a valid GST Registration Certificate clearly indicating the registered office add ress in Kerala as documentary proof.

2. RELEVANT SUPPLY AND INSTALLATION EXPERIENCE 2.1. The bidder must possess relevant experience in the supply, installation and commissioning of similar p roducts. 2.2. The bidder shall submit copies of at least three work orders for similar supplies executed through the GeM portal in Kerala during FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26. 2.3. The bidder/seller must have successfully supplied products of the same brand during the preceding tw o years and shall submit supporting purchase orders, invoices or completion certificates as proof. 3. GE M PORTAL EXPERIENCE 3.1. The bidder must have a minimum of seven (7) years of experience on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal. 3.2. Documentary evidence supporting the completion of seven years of GeM registration/experience shall be uploaded along with the bid. 4. SERVICE CENTRE AND TECHNICAL SUPPORT 4.1. A functional service centre must be available in the consignee district. 4.2. The bidder shall submit documentary proof of the service centre address. 4.3. The service centre must have qualified technical engineers capable of providing warranty services, tro ubleshooting and maintenance support. 4.4. The bidder/OEM shall maintain an adequate service network across India to ensure prompt after-sales support. 5. PRODUCT VALIDITY AND OEM STATUS 5.1. The bidder shall quote only current, non-obsolete OEM models with active warranty and technical supp ort. 5.2. The offered products must be genuine and manufactured by the respective OEM. 5.3. The bidder shall be either the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an authorized channel partn er of the proposed products. 6. OEM AUTHORIZATION 6.1. An OEM Authorization Certificate / Manufacturer's Authorization Form (MAF), specifically issued for this tender by the respective OEM, shall be submitted along with the bid. 6.2. The authorization shall clearly establish the bidder's eligibility to participate in the tender and supply t he offered products. 7. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS AND COMPLIANCE 7.1. The specifications mentioned in the bid represent the minimum essential technical requirements. 7.2. The bidder must ensure complete compliance with all the technical specifications mentioned in the bid . 7.3. Detailed product datasheets, technical brochures and supporting documents shall be uploaded along with the bid for verification. 7.4. Any deviation from the specified technical requirements shall be clearly indicated in the technical com pliance statement. 8. ISO CERTIFICATION 8.1. Both the bidder/vendor and the OEM must possess valid ISO certifications relevant to their respective business activities. 8.2. Copies of valid ISO certificates shall be uploaded along with the bid. 9. OEM WARRANTY AND AFTER-SALES SUPPORT

9.1. The successful bidder shall submit the applicable OEM warranty certificate at the time of delivery. 9.2. The seller shall ensure rectification or replacement of defective products during the warranty period in accordance with the applicable warranty terms. 9.3. The bidder/OEM shall provide installation, commissioning, user training and necessary technical suppo rt. 9.4. All warranty services shall be provided as per the warranty conditions specified in the bid. 10. GE M SELLER RATING 10.1. The bidder must have a minimum final GeM seller rating of 4-Star (LBL). 10.2. The bidder shall upload a screenshot of the latest GeM seller rating dashboard as documentary proof . 11. GEM BUSINESS VOLUME 11.1. The bidder must have achieved a minimum cumulative business volume of ₹1 Crore (Rupees One Cr ore Only) or above through the GeM portal. 11.2. Supporting documentary evidence from the GeM seller dashboard, order summary or other verifiable GeM records shall be submitted along with the bid. 12. FINANCIAL TURNOVER 12.1. The bidder shall submit CA-certified turnover details for the last three financial years: FY 2023-24 FY 2024-25 FY 2025-26 12.2. The submitted documents shall serve as evidence of the bidder's financial capability and business pe rformance. 13. PRICING AND SCOPE OF SUPPLY 13.1. The quoted bid price must be inclusive of all costs associated with supply, transportation, installation , testing, commissioning and basic configuration of the offered products. 13.2. The quoted amount shall cover all activities and requirements specified in the bid and its accompany ing estimate, wherever applicable. 13.3. No additional charges shall be payable for activities already included in the quoted scope of supply. 14. DEMONSTRATION 14.1. After completion of the technical evaluation, the bidder shall arrange an onsite demonstration of the offered product at the buyer's office, if requested by the buyer. 14.2. The demonstration shall be conducted within the time specified by the buyer. 14.3. The offered product must demonstrate compliance with the essential technical specifications mentio ned in the bid. 15. MANDATORY DOCUMENTATION 15.1. The bidder shall upload all certificates, declarations and supporting documents specifically requeste d in the bid document, ATC and corrigenda, if any. 15.2. Failure to submit mandatory documents may result in rejection of the bid, subject to applicable GeM rules and bid conditions. 15.3. All submitted documents must be valid, genuine and verifiable. 16. SELF-CERTIFICATION

16.1. The bidder shall upload a self-certification on the company's official letterhead confirming complianc e with all applicable clauses and requirements mentioned in this ATC. 17. NON-BLACKLISTING DECLARATION 17.1. The bidder shall submit a self-declaration on the company's official letterhead stating that the firm h as not been blacklisted or debarred by GeM or any Government organization during the preceding five yea rs. 18. BUYER'S RIGHTS AND GENERAL CONDITIONS 18.1. The buyer reserves the right to evaluate the technical suitability of the offered products based on the specifications and supporting documents submitted by the bidder. 18.2. The buyer reserves the right to accept or reject any bid in accordance with applicable GeM rules, pro curement guidelines and bid conditions. 18.3. All bidders shall comply with the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC), Special Terms and Conditions (STC), bid-specific conditions and relevant Government procurement guidelines. 18.4. All eligibility requirements and ATC conditions shall be applied uniformly to all participating bidders. 18.5. Any clarification or additional documents required during technical evaluation shall be dealt with stri ctly in accordance with applicable GeM provisions. . 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 4. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 5. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 6. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted.
